subject: Farsight Tech renewal — exec review requested for concessions
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna@farsighttech.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Contract renewal for Farsight — options and concerns

Neha,

We're approaching our renewal on Jun 1 and I wanted to surface a few risks on our side that might impact renewal. Our leadership is tightening budgets and they asked us to see if Redwood can do any of the following for this term:

- 20% list discount or a one-time credit to offset cost
- Reset to a 6-month term instead of 12 to align with procurement windows
- Add an availability SLA (we need clarity around uptime and credits)

We like the product and the teams have been great, but this is a timing + budget constraint. I attached a short renewal_summary. Can you let me know what flexibility you have? We need an answer by next Tuesday (Apr 21).

Thanks,
Anna Lopez
Director of Platform Operations
Farsight Tech

Attachment: renewal_summary.pdf (1.2MB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna@farsighttech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract renewal for Farsight — options and concerns

Anna — thanks for the clear note and the summary. Appreciate the timeline.

Quick response: we want to keep Farsight on the platform and will escalate requests to get you a proposal that balances your budget constraints and our pricing guardrails. To be transparent up front, a 20% across-the-board list discount is outside standard renewal concessions for this segment, but there are a few levers we can pull:

- One-time credit (applied at renewal) — easier to approve quickly
- Shorter term (6 months) — acceptable but increases price per month; can offer a modest credit to offset
- SLA add-on — we can offer an SLA amendment with availability commitments but needs legal sign-off and a technical review to confirm the SLA target

I'm looping in Marissa and Vivek to request exec review for a concession package. If possible, can you confirm: current ARR/licensing line referenced in the summary and whether there are any active expansion opportunities we can tie to a concession?

I'll follow up with a formal escalation note to leadership.

-Neha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 08:10:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Contract renewal for Farsight — options and concerns

Neha — please prepare an exec approval packet with the following by EOD Apr 20:

1) One-page deal summary (customer health, ARR impacted, renewal date)
2) Recommended concession package and rationale (list price impact, net ARR retained)
3) Suggested guardrails (conditional approvals, churn risk, sales/CS commitments)
4) Any legal/regulatory risks for SLA add-on

For reference, include the mutual_action_plan.docx and a quick pricing impact sheet. Jordan — please stand by for legal language if we move forward with SLA terms. Vivek, I'll defer to you on the maximum concession we can authorize from an exec perspective; recommend we include a tiered option (A/B) rather than a single ask.

-Marissa
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: mutual_action_plan.docx

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec packet: Farsight renewal (RW-FT-2026-041) — recommendation

Team — attaching the packet and my recommendation below. I confirmed with Anna that the customer will sign if we can provide a mix of discount + credit + SLA amendment. She also confirmed there is a nascent expansion conversation in Q3 (billing analytics pilot) that could add ~$60k ARR.

Recommendation (tiered):

Option A (preferred to retain):
- 15% one-time discount on renewal invoice
- One-time usage credit equal to 1 month of committed spend
- SLA add-on: 99.95% availability target with standard remedies (requires legal sign-off)
- Term: reset to 12 months (customer prefers predictability)

Option B (conservative):
- 10% one-time discount
- One-time credit equal to 0.5 month committed spend
- SLA: standard doc only, no financial remedy
- Term: 6 months

Impact: Option A reduces first-year net ARR by ~13% (see pricing_impact.xlsx) but materially increases renewal likelihood and preserves expansion runway. Option B reduces net ARR by ~8% with lower commit from us.

Ask: Vivek — approval to pursue Option A up to the following guardrails: max discount 15%, max credit 1 month, SLA amendment limited to 99.95% and standard credit table. If not approved, request direction between Option B or a counter we can offer to the customer by Tue 21 Apr close of business.

Attachments: pricing_impact.xlsx

Thanks,
Neha

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec packet: Farsight renewal (RW-FT-2026-041) — recommendation

Neha / Marissa — reviewed. Thank you for the concise packet. I approve pursuing a constrained version of Option A with the following executive-level exceptions/conditions:

- Approved concession: up to 10% one-time discount and one-time credit up to 1 month committed spend.
- SLA: we can add the 99.95% availability amendment but only as a non-financial SLA (operational escalation + credits capped to a single-service credit in the first year). Legal (Jordan) to confirm precise wording.
- Term: prefer 12-month reset to preserve visibility; ok to accept 6-month only if customer insists but flag to finance.
- Condition: require a signed mutual action plan and a written commitment on the Q3 pilot to be included as a clause (net new expansion milestone) — this helps protect ARR and ties the concession to expansion.

Neha — please present the approved package to the customer and close the commercial changes in DocuSign. Marissa — please follow-up with finance to confirm reporting for the credit. Jordan — please draft SLA amendment language and the expansion milestone clause.

-Vivek
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
